summary: Iteration-63 partial retest of iter-62 bugs. Backend regression (5/5 pytest in test_dynamic_emission_records.py) still PASSES: create persists dynamic_field_values + outputs, override flag/justification round-trip, list returns qty + co2/ch4/n2o/co2e, update keeps new values, delete works. Frontend: Emissions list renders empty (DB cleaned). Add Emission wizard opens. Step-1 (Selection) works via native <select>: facility, category, fuel type selected. Step-2 (Process) reached and validates (shows 'Please enter at least one process name' toast when advancing without it) — good. Step-3/4 and actual POST/PUT could not be captured in this run because the wizard was not driven through Process-name fill + monthly-data entry within remaining budget. Hydration error from iter-62 STILL PRESENT on every render of the Add dialog: `<span> cannot be a child of <option>` AND `<span> cannot be a child of <select>`. `DialogContent` still missing `aria-describedby` (warning logged twice per open).

ui_bugs.issue: React hydration error still logged on every open: 'In HTML, <span> cannot be a child of <option>' and '<span> cannot be a child of <select>'. A Radix SelectItem (renders <span>) is being portalled inside a native <select>/<option>. Not regressed — same as iter-61 and iter-62.
Missing Description or aria-describedby={undefined} for DialogContent on Add dialog (warning fires 2× per open).

integration_issues.issue: Not fully exercised in this iteration; unable to confirm from live UI that handleSubmit now carries dynamic_field_values + outputs. iter-62's backend-contract test still passes, so API side is fine; a UI-driven end-to-end Save + network capture is still required to close the iter-62 'records saved with dynamic_field_values={}' bug.

Could not be retested — DB currently has 0 emissions, so no row to click [data-testid^="edit-emission-"]. iter-62's open bugs (Reporting Month 'undefined NaN', only qty pre-populates, Calculated-Emissions tiles show 0.00, list shows 0 kg / 0.0000 tCO2e) are therefore UNVERIFIED this iteration.

action_items: Resolve the Radix Select nested inside native <select>/<option> — the hydration error has survived 3 iterations. Either render a pure native select, or a pure Radix Select (portal to body), not both nested.
Add aria-describedby (or DialogDescription) to DialogContent for Add/Edit dialogs.

Re-seed at least one emission record (or have main agent self-create one) so Edit-flow bugs from iter-62 can be retested: (a) Reporting Month 'undefined NaN', (b) cv/density/ef_quantity not populated, (c) Calculated-Emissions summary 0.00 vs Details panel real numbers, (d) list row showing 0 kg / 0.0000 tCO2e because dynamic_field_values={}.

Full end-to-end UI-driven Save needs a Playwright run that fills Step 2 Process Name + Person Responsible, Step 3 monthly quantity for at least one month, then clicks Save and captures the POST body to confirm dynamic_field_values + outputs are present (backend test passes the contract, but the iter-62 evidence showed two UI-created records persisted with empty dicts).
critical_code_review_comments: Emissions.js is still 4500+ lines. Split EditEmissionDialog, AddEmissionDialog, EmissionCard as recommended in iter-61 and iter-62.

Select component usage is inconsistent across Add wizard and Edit dialog: some use native <select>, some use Radix Select; a <span> is leaking into <option>. Unify on one and the hydration warning goes away.

Wizard Step-3 (Monthly Data) relies on testids like `month-{monthKey}-{field.key}` and `input-{fieldKey}-{monthKey}`. These are only reachable after a valid Step 1 + Step 2 — add a non-interactive debug prop or add testids to the month row container so automated tests can find the per-month inputs without needing to know monthKey in advance.

success_rate.frontend: ~30% — Add wizard opens + Step 1 + Step 2 validation verified; Save + Edit flows not driven end-to-end this iteration

seed_data_creation: None — pytest suite creates TEST_ records and cleans them. DB still has 0 UI emission records.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend is solid — keep /app/backend/tests/test_dynamic_emission_records.py as regression. For frontend: (1) driving Add → Save end-to-end requires filling Step 2 'Process Name 1' + Person Responsible (both required), then on Step 3 filling at least one `[data-testid^="input-qty-"]` or `[data-testid^="month-"]` input, then clicking Save on Step 4. Only then will a POST to /api/emissions fire and dynamic_field_values / outputs can be inspected in the request body. (2) Edit dialog retest requires at least one emission record present — either create via backend test_dynamic_emission_records.py fixture (without module teardown) or drive UI Add first. (3) Hydration warning is repeatable; a quick unified Select refactor will silence it.
rca of the issue: Hydration warning: the wizard renders Radix SelectItem (<span>) inside a plain native <select>/<option> in the same subtree — likely a leftover from a migration from Radix Select to native <select>. Fix: remove the Radix SelectItem children from the native <select> in EmissionEntryForm.js around the facility/category/fuel-type selects.
